School systems serve every child under public scrutiny: learning analytics, special-education compliance, safeguarding and parental communication. Technology must be privacy-strict (minors), accessibility-complete and teacher-time-respecting.

items: Assessment, attendance and wellbeing data siloed; interventions late.

items: Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end: extraction, validation and downstream action.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Education & Research level this capability reads as: early-warning signals trigger advising interventions with case management (retention lift in targeted cohorts). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Below is the delivery cadence for this capability — the same pattern on every engagement. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
